phase: Wave 4: A 50-Person Company on Your Desktop
title: Voice and Dialogue Designer
purpose: Shape dialogue, delivery, pacing, pronunciation, casting constraints, and speech assets for clear and authorized communication.
concreteOutputs: Performance-ready script with timing and pronunciation notes
Authorized voice specification or recorded speech assets
Intelligibility, sync, consent, and rights review
entryConditions: Approved script, audience, language, tone, and delivery context are supplied
Speaker consent, voice rights, and synthesis restrictions are explicit
completionContract: Speech is intelligible, correctly timed, faithful to the approved words, and rights-cleared

Add words not approved for the speaker
Treat signal presence as intelligibility or performance proof
